data_as_of: Regular-session quotes from Yahoo Finance v1 screener and v7 quote API, ~10:52–10:53 a.m. CT Nov 23 (Russell 2000 and VIX ~10:37 a.m. CT; futures ~10:42 a.m. CT). Prior closes are Friday Nov 20.
headline: Stocks surge — S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq-100 +6.7% — after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO (NVDA +31%); CrowdStrike −11% on its $43.9B all-stock Zscaler deal.
drivers: Stocks are sharply higher, recovering all of Friday's drop: the S&P 500 is up ~4.7% and the Nasdaq-100 ~6.7% after Friday left the S&P more than 10% below its October record. The trigger was Nvidia's board reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO at 7:55 a.m. CT, 11 days after he resigned; the board said senior US government input left it confident his return poses no national security risk, though its independent investigation continues. NVDA is up ~31%, pulling chips and AI infrastructure with it — MU +18%, TSM +15%, INTC +12%, SOXX +13%, and neoclouds CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN up 21–27%. The VIX fell ~22% to ~28, oil is down ~3.8% and gold up ~4%. In deals, CrowdStrike (−11%) agreed to buy Zscaler (+15%) for 1.135 shares each (~$43.9B EV), and Capricor (−76%) got an FDA rejection. Holiday-shortened week: GDP and PCE come Wednesday, markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and close early Friday.
